what: The challenge's run settings, one per maker, as AG Opus answered the seven points, through G, 15 November 2026, morning. Recorded before any AI is asked; the run records the exact model returned for every answer.

every_call.route: each maker's standard interface, standard calls, never batch, no prompt caching (point 7)
every_call.length: never sent, except where an interface requires it (point 2)
every_call.answers: ten from each AI with the paper with its dated notes; three more with the paper as it stood on 13 November 2026 (plan, draft 6)

anthropic.max_tokens_why: point 2: the interface requires it; the model's own maximum output, 128,000 tokens, so nothing we send cuts an answer short
anthropic.thinking: always on in this model; the parameter is not sent
anthropic.fallbacks: none: a refusal is the model's own answer, shown in its own words, and no other model answers in its place

google.why: point 6: the model Google's own page calls its most capable; point 3: streamed, so nothing is cut at 32,768 tokens

mistral.note: Large 4 accepts low, medium or high, and not xhigh or max

deepinfra.why: point 1: the maker's own documentation governs
deepinfra.checked: settings-check/deepinfra_max.json, 15 November 2026: one neutral prompt, never the question; DeepInfra took max, HTTP 200, 150 reasoning tokens came back, normal stop

outside.marks: every answer but xAI's, and our own eight roads

markers.desk: AG Opus, and a fresh session of AG Opus's that G opens: no interface call from WC
markers.why: point 4: the markers' top settings; the marks are what the page stands on

sorting: point 5: every answer is sorted by each of the three markers, alone, into the four kinds of section 8: a road, no road found, a refusal, withheld. Where any marker sorts an answer as a road, all three mark it as a road. An answer that finds no road, but shows the strongest road it tried, has that road marked as every road is; if the marks find it does not break where the AI says it does, the page shows that. A refusal is shown in the AI's own words, and gets no road marks.
from: AG Opus, through G, 15 November 2026, morning: 00_for_WC_2026-11-15_the_seven_settings_and_the_room.md, section 1
